soil.name: Soil
soil.description: Dug ground. Laid as grass, dirt, podzol or the grasses (V: the colour).

stone.description: Laid as stone, dark stone, granite, diorite or road (V: the colour).

sand.description: Laid as sand or red sand (V: the colour).

clay.description: Laid as clay or the terracottas (V: the colour).

wood.description: From felled trees. Laid as wood, pale wood or birch wood (V: the colour). Floats, burns.

leaves.description: From felled trees. Laid as green, light, autumn or red leaves (V: the colour). Floats, burns fast.

bucket.name: Bucket
bucket.description: Holds 9 tiles of water (3 bricks). Left: scoop from still water, or fill from a source. Right: pour a brick.

source_bucket.name: Source bucket
source_bucket.description: Carries one source brick, water or lava. Left: take a source. Right: put it down as a spring.

water_source.name: Water source
water_source.description: Creative: pours an endless water source in every stud of the block.

water_brick.name: Water brick
water_brick.description: Creative: pours still water, 3 tiles a stud.

lava_source.name: Lava source
lava_source.description: Creative: pours a lava source in every stud of the block.

mega_pickaxe.name: Mega Pickaxe
mega_pickaxe.description: Breaks a 5 x 5 face of blocks at a time (the face looked at, one block deep), held: about four times as fast as the pickaxe.

small_backpack.name: Small Backpack
small_backpack.description: Worn in the backpack slot: 9 storage slots. What is in it goes where it goes.

medium_backpack.name: Medium Backpack
medium_backpack.description: Worn in the backpack slot: 18 storage slots. What is in it goes where it goes.

large_backpack.name: Large Backpack
large_backpack.description: Worn in the backpack slot: 27 storage slots. What is in it goes where it goes.

workbench.name: Workbench
workbench.description: Place it: recipes marked "at a workbench" can be made within 4 m of it (E, the Craft tab).

furnace.name: Furnace
furnace.description: Place it: recipes marked "at a furnace" (ore into tools) can be made within 4 m of it.

chest.name: Chest
chest.description: Holds 27 stacks. Place it, then right-click it to open.
